rubric.evidence: Verified directly against Chromium download_utils.cc (request->mode = params->fetch_request_mode()), features.cc (kBackgroundFetchCorsEnforcement FEATURE_ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT), background_fetch_manager.cc (no-cors TypeError), background_fetch_delegate_proxy.cc (Origin header), background_fetch_job_controller.cc (RequiresCorsPreflight, progress suppression, FETCH_ERROR masking), background_fetch_cross_origin_filter.cc, WICG Background Fetch spec, BCD, webstatus.dev, and ChromeStatus 6210300985606144 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 6210300985606144 is listed under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=157 with exact listing name 'CORS enforcement for Background Fetch'; slug cors-enforcement-for-background-fetch matches slugify(); H1 matches listing name; declared ChromeStatus row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6210300985606144.

Covers all 3 behavioral surfaces (request mode & Network Service CORS enforcement, RequiresCorsPreflight blocking, and responseReady/backgroundfetchfail failure handling) across all 9 reference-contract dimensions.

Explains the architectural shift from RequestMode::kNavigate to originating fetch_request_mode, exact credentialed vs non-credentialed Access-Control-Allow-Origin rules, why cross-origin preflights fail with fetch-error, and how progress suppression prevents cross-origin size leaks.

Embeds live HTTP-200 Chrome Platform Showcase URL auditor (v154/cors-enforcement-for-background-fetch/what-changed/) with sandbox and referrerpolicy, links both sibling demos, and provides verified JS registration and Service Worker failure-handling code blocks.

Honestly reports Limited availability (Background Fetch is Chromium-only: Chrome 74+/Edge 79+, CORS enforcement enabled by default in Chrome 157 desktop/Android; Firefox and Safari unsupported) and lists concrete migration fixes for broken cross-origin fetches.

Every visible source and citation label links directly to primary artifacts with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; all CPS demo URLs and parent conformance HTML/JSON verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27; feature-root links marked data-demo-rel='related'.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions and <pre tabindex='0'>, descriptive iframe title, and visible :focus-visible outline.
